data.query: qZense Labs competitors alternatives food-quality sensing technology
data.answer: Qzense Labs' competitors in the food-quality sensing technology space include Senorics, which operates in material sensing technology and offers a handheld spectroscopic device for material analysis in various sectors including food quality assessment. Other competitors mentioned include Sample6, Allergy Amulet, and Kernel labs, which provide different solutions for food safety and diagnostics.

Senorics [...] Senorics

Senorics operates in Material Sensing technology within the material analysis sector. The company offers a handheld spectroscopic device that allows for the analysis of material compositions. This device is applicable in textile analysis, cannabis testing, food quality assessment, and other areas. It was founded in 2017 and is based in Dresden, Germany.

Loading... [...] Qzense Labs operates in the fresh food supply chain by providing data-driven solutions in the technology sector. The company offers internet-of-things (IoT)-based automation and analytics solutions that assess factors such as internal spoilage, ripeness, sweetness, and shelf life. Qzense Labs serves the agriculture and seafood technology sectors, offering tools for grading and managing fresh food inventory. It was founded in 2019 and is based in Bengaluru, India.
